title: Discovering Nanshan Museum
description: Piaoyan Jiang introduced Nanshan Museum, Shenzhen’s largest museum, through its flagship exhibition "The Story of Nanshan"—spanning ancient history, modern struggles, and reform-era miracles. Witness heroic tales like the 1858 Nantou City defense and China’s transformative spirit. With bilingual exhibits, it bridges global audiences to Shenzhen’s legacy and the nation’s indomitable rise.
